mapper.select: select t.id, t.org_id as orgId, t.event_code as eventCode, t.event_name as eventName, t.biz_pid as bizPid, t.template_id as templateId, t.status, st.template_name as templateName from sms_autosend_event t left join sms_template_set st on t.template_id=st.id where st.template_status = 1 and t.id = #{id}
